title: Your website should be a printout of what your business knows.
hook: Your website should be a printout of what your business knows, not a second business to run.
thesis: FYD represents a business as an object graph: one tenant truth that compiles into a website, a concierge, a campaign, a social presence. The site is one projection of that truth, so it never drifts out of sync with what the business actually knows. This post teaches the object-graph-as-compiler idea in under a minute.

verified: FYD's pipeline compiles one tenant object graph into products: SiteSpec website, Ask FYD, campaign spec (FYD ten-day directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
Tenant truth flows SOURCE, ACQUIRE, OBSERVE, EVIDENCE, OBJECT GRAPH, SITE SPEC, RENDER (directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
